messages:
emma_marketing: Quick sync  Lakeside Meetup is two days out. Need final: booth checklist, speaker slide deadline, swag sizing fix, and the post-event webinar RSVP flow. Who can lock their piece today?

liam_events: I'll handle courier and floorplan. Courier needs weight dims by tomorrow morning.

sophia_design: Updating the benchmark one-pager with smaller copy and a tiny chart. Will upload print-ready by tonight.

owen_sales: I'll wire the lead form (QR -> short form -> HubSpot) and add a hidden field event=lakeside_meetup. Also building hot-lead webhook to #sdr-inbox.

emma_marketing: Swag snag: shirts missing two XLs. Options: swap sizes after event via voucher or rush-print. Prefer voucher to avoid delays.

liam_events: Voucher is fine. Also confirm speaker @nina_research for 11:00 slot; she needs mic + HDMI.

sophia_design: Noted. Adding a micro-CTA on the postcard: "Get benchmarks + webinar invite" with checkbox in the form.

owen_sales: Posting Typeform link and Zap mapping by EOD. Will include the voucher flow for tee claims.

ops_bot: Reminder: Any AV request must be submitted 24hrs prior.

emma_marketing: Owners summary: Logistics: @liam_events, Creative+prints: @sophia_design, Lead routing: @owen_sales, Post-event nurture + social: @emma_marketing. Close items and report back by tonight. :thumbsup:
